<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of "size" bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of "size" bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 2*size bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="size" value="4">Size parameter for the multiplier.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="mul_a_ext" width_description="[7:0]">Extended multiplicand signal with 'size' number of zero bits added at the most significant bit positions.</assign>
        <assign id="mul_b_ext" width_description="[7:0]">Extended multiplier signal with 'size' number of zero bits added at the most significant bit positions.</assign>
        <generate>
            <for id="i" start="0" end="size-1">
                <if id="condition1" test="mul_b[i]==1'b1">
                    <assign id="partial_product[i]" width_description="[7:0]">Partial product generated by multiplying the multiplicand with the corresponding bit in the multiplier.</assign>
                </if>
                <else id="condition2">
                    <assign id="partial_product[i]" width_description="[7:0]">Partial product set to 0 if the corresponding bit in the multiplier is 0.</assign>
                </else>
            </for>
        </generate>
        <reg id="register[0][0]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the first stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[0][1]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the second stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[0][2]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the third stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[0][3]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the fourth stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[1][0]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the fifth stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[1][1]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the sixth stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[1][2]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the seventh stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[1][3]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the eighth stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[2][0]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the ninth stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[2][1]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the tenth stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[2][2]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the eleventh stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[2][3]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the twelfth stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[3][0]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the thirteenth stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[3][1]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the fourteenth stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[3][2]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the fifteenth stage of partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="register[3][3]" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the sixteenth stage of partial products.</reg>
        <always id="addition_stage1" type="sequential_logic" posedge_clk="true" negedge_rst_n="true">
            <case id="case_statement1">
                <when id="when_case1" test="i==0">
                    <assign id="register[0][0]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[0][0] and partial_product[0].</assign>
                    <assign id="register[0][1]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[0][1] and partial_product[1].</assign>
                    <assign id="register[0][2]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[0][2] and partial_product[2].</assign>
                    <assign id="register[0][3]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[0][3] and partial_product[3].</assign>
                </when>
                <when id="when_case2" test="i==1">
                    <assign id="register[1][0]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[1][0] and register[0][0].</assign>
                    <assign id="register[1][1]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[1][1] and register[0][1].</assign>
                    <assign id="register[1][2]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[1][2] and register[0][2].</assign>
                    <assign id="register[1][3]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[1][3] and register[0][3].</assign>
                </when>
                <when id="when_case3" test="i==2">
                    <assign id="register[2][0]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[2][0] and register[1][0].</assign>
                    <assign id="register[2][1]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[2][1] and register[1][1].</assign>
                    <assign id="register[2][2]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[2][2] and register[1][2].</assign>
                    <assign id="register[2][3]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[2][3] and register[1][3].</assign>
                </when>
                <when id="when_case4" test="i==3">
                    <assign id="register[3][0]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[3][0] and register[2][0].</assign>
                    <assign id="register[3][1]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[3][1] and register[2][1].</assign>
                    <assign id="register[3][2]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[3][2] and register[2][2].</assign>
                    <assign id="register[3][3]" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of register[3][3] and register[2][3].</assign>
                </when>
            </case>
        </always>
        <always id="final_addition" type="sequential_logic" posedge_clk="true" negedge_rst_n="true">
            <assign id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Sum of all registers in the last stage.</assign>
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        Extending input signals by adding 'size' number of zero bits at the most significant bit positions.
        Generating partial products based on the corresponding bit in the multiplier being 1 or 0.
        Using registers to store intermediate sums at different stages of the pipeline.
        Performing addition operations between registers and partial products at specific stages.
        Calculating the final product by summing up the values stored in the registers.
    </implementation>
</module>
